title: Core, Buffer and Eco-sensitive Zones
alt: MHTR core, buffer and eco-sensitive zones (2020 MHTR and 2021 Bhainsrorgarh) drawn from Rajasthan Forest Department map files
summary: One view of every legal layer the Forest Department's public map files can draw: the 2013 core and buffer (approximate, because no file separates them), the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary added to the core in 2023, the one small 2023 buffer block a file draws outside the 2013 files (Barkheda; the Kota file's other two whole blocks lie inside the 2013 files), and both eco-sensitive zones. The legend gives each layer's measured area against its notified area.
useFor: Use this as the overall picture of how the reserve's zones fit together. Read the data-gaps map next: about 181 km² of the notified 2023 reserve cannot be drawn from any public file.
sources: Rajasthan Forest Department map files (2018 sanctuary and park files, reserve file, 2026 ESZ files); notifications of 9 Apr 2013 and 5 Oct 2023; MoEFCC S.O. 4268(E) (2020) and S.O. 3683(E) (2021); OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps for rivers, roads and towns

title: Where Public MHTR Maps Fall Short
alt: Map of the parts of the 2023 MHTR reserve no public file draws: core villages as points, partly added forest blocks, and gaps between files
summary: Shows what the public files leave out. The 21 revenue villages added to the core in 2023 have no boundaries in any public file; 18 are marked by their OpenStreetMap village points. Six forest blocks were added to the buffer only in part, by area or compartment, so only the whole blocks can be outlined. The map also marks where the ESZ bands cross those blocks, so some land may be both ESZ and 2023 buffer, and a 6.2 km² area around Daulatpura that the reserve files close round but none includes; the 2020 ESZ file covers most of it.
useFor: Use this before quoting an area or making an overlay, and when asking the Forest Department for the 2023 schedules as maps.
sources: Rajasthan Forest Department map files, including the Kota (2018) and Bundi (2023) forest-block files; notification of 5 Oct 2023; OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps for village points

title: Eco-sensitive Zones of 2020 and 2021
alt: Map of the 2020 MHTR and 2021 Bhainsrorgarh eco-sensitive zones around the reserve, with the hole in the official ESZ file outlined
summary: Two notifications set eco-sensitive zones here. The 2020 MHTR ESZ (248.70 km² notified) was drawn around the 2013 reserve; the Forest Department's file for it is an outer envelope of reserve plus zone (1,003.91 km² on the WGS84 ellipsoid), so the band shown is the envelope minus the reserve, park and sanctuary files. The 2021 Bhainsrorgarh ESZ (304.70 km² notified, 300.33 km² drawn) surrounds the sanctuary that became core in 2023.
useFor: Use this to see where ESZ rules apply, and why the envelope area must not be quoted as the ESZ area.
sources: MoEFCC S.O. 4268(E), 25 Nov 2020, and S.O. 3683(E), 10 Sep 2021; Forest Department ESZ files MHTR.kmz and BHAINSROAD ESZ.kmz, as on 1 Jun 2026; OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps

title: Reserve and Landscape Context
alt: Orientation map of MHTR and its eco-sensitive zones with districts, other protected areas, rivers, main roads, railways and towns
summary: Places the reserve, drawn from Forest Department files, among the districts, neighbouring sanctuaries, rivers, main roads and towns of the Chambal landscape. Neighbouring protected areas are OpenStreetMap outlines and are indicative only.
useFor: Use this first when explaining where MHTR sits in the wider Kota, Bundi, Chittorgarh and Jhalawar landscape.
sources: Rajasthan Forest Department map files; OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps for districts, other protected areas, rivers, roads and places

title: Terrain and Ridge Relief
alt: Shaded relief of MHTR showing north-west to south-east ridges and valleys, rivers, the reserve and reserve-plus-ESZ outlines
summary: DEM-derived shaded relief with elevation tints shows the long ridges and valleys that run north-west to south-east. Highest and lowest points are marked inside the reserve-plus-ESZ outline.
useFor: Use this to explain why slopes, valleys and long ridges shape habitat, visibility, patrol access and movement.
sources: Mapzen Terrain Tiles on AWS (built from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and other sources); Rajasthan Forest Department map files; OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps

title: Water Systems and Hydrology
alt: Hydrology map of the Mukundara landscape: rivers, reservoirs, canals, main roads, towns and the reserve outlines
summary: Rivers, reservoirs, canals and drainage around the reserve over light shaded relief, with the main water bodies labelled on the feature they name.
useFor: Use this for dry-season water, wetland value, riparian corridors and water-linked movement.
sources: OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps; Mapzen Terrain Tiles on AWS (built from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and other sources); Rajasthan Forest Department map files

title: Elevation Zones and Contours
alt: Elevation bands and 50 m contours for MHTR with rivers and the reserve and reserve-plus-ESZ outlines
summary: Elevation bands in metres, 50 m contours (bold every 100 m) and the highest and lowest points inside the reserve-plus-ESZ outline.
useFor: Use this when discussing ridges, lower valleys, drainage floors and terrain-driven microhabitats, with approximate DEM elevations.
sources: Mapzen Terrain Tiles on AWS (built from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and other sources); Rajasthan Forest Department map files; OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps

title: Land Cover and Habitat Context
alt: ESA WorldCover 2021 land cover around MHTR with the reserve outlines and class shares inside the reserve and ESZ
summary: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 classes with the share of each class inside the reserve and inside the eco-sensitive zones. WorldCover ended with the 2021 reference year, so this is a dated baseline, not current land cover.
useFor: Use this as a 2021 habitat baseline, then check later change and finer habitat detail with dated imagery, field notes and forest records.
sources: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (CC BY 4.0); Rajasthan Forest Department map files
